regime: Weaker dollar and lower yields lifting metals after the Democratic sweep
takeaway: Democrats won control of Congress, and the dollar fell about 0.6% to a four-week low while the 10-year yield dropped about 5 bp to near 4.90%. That lifted gold about 3% back above $4,000 and silver about 4% to near $52, with gold miners up more than 5% before the open. Stock futures recovered from an overnight drop and the S&P 500 is set to open about 1% higher, while today's services survey and Friday's jobs report could still swing yields.
